# KaTeX 0.16.11

These are the `katex.min.js`, `katex.min.css`, and WOFF2 fonts from the
`katex@0.16.11` npm package. KaTeX is MIT licensed; see `LICENSE`.

`build/build.py` inlines the script, CSS, and WOFF2 fonts into each generated
chapter so its equations render when the single HTML file is opened offline.
The other course pages on edu.gradual-lab.dev use KaTeX separately.
